entities.summary: Giuseppe Motta was a Swiss politician. He served as President of the Swiss Confederation 5 times. He was a member of the Swiss Federal Council (1911–1940) and President of the assembly of league of nations (1924–1925). He was a Catholic-conservative foreign minister and a staunch opponent of communism and Stalinism.
